build: pnpm install && pnpm --filter "vue-lynx..." build && cd packages/benchmark && node harness/build-unified.mjs --only=vdom-ifr-et,vapor-ifr,react

vdom-ifr-et.description: Vue Lynx vdom top config (vdom +b +ifr; legacy id vdom-ifr-et)

vapor-ifr.description: Vue Lynx vapor top config (vapor +b +ifr; legacy id vapor-ifr)

note: Black-box fixtures: only the .web.bundle files are vendored. They are served unmodified into <lynx-view> by web/run-web.mjs; the app workloads mirror app/src operation-for-operation. The harness host runs @lynx-js/web-core 0.22.2 for every cell (the fork built against 0.22.1 — the host runtime is shared, so the comparison stays same-host).
